title: into_response: hand-rolled RFC 7807 JSON via serde_json::Map
description: RequestError::into_response() builds the RFC 7807 Problem Details body by manually inserting keys into a serde_json::Map. A #[derive(Serialize)] private struct would be cleaner, type-safe, and immune to key-name typos. Current code compiles correctly but is harder to maintain and review.
notes: Proposal: private ProblemDetails struct with #[serde(rename_all=camelCase)] fields, built from RequestError fields. No public API change needed since this is a private impl detail.
